source.normalization: Original pieces have unit circumradius, so icosahedron edge length is 1.0514622242382672; centers divided by this edge. Apply a proper rigid rotation to align ALL published octahedron outer vertices with the project canonical solid (normalized discrepancy 6.66e-16). Fit piece rotations to ALL source mesh vertices (maximum discrepancy 1.06e-15). Convert container circumradius into edge ratio R/(0.70710678118654757 * 1.0514622242382672). Add standard 1e-7 clearance without transferring discovery credit.
